LW hazard: simulator uses 1 stall + MEM→ALU forwarding, hardware uses 2 stalls + no LW data forwarding

Simulator: insertStalls(1) in getFwdValFromEX() for regLoadMEM, then forwards mem_to_wb.mem_out via getFwdValFromMEM().
Hardware: LW stall counter "01" = 2 total stall cycles (1 detection + 1 counter), register bank provides value after WB. No LW data forwarding path exists.

Same results with NOP-padded programs. Reassess after HW Phase 3 adds LW data forwarding.
